title: Is Code Dead & The $1B Solo Startup Myth - Tom Hulme's conversation with Guy Podjarny
description:
Dive into an engaging conversation with Tom Hulme as he explores the groundbreaking shift from a code-centric to a spec-centric approach in software development. This pivotal change is at the heart of Tessl's mission. Tom shares his expertise on cloud-native development, the evolving tool ecosystem, and the future role of AI and LLMs in software development.

What You'll Learn:
- Understand the transition from code-centric to spec-centric development.
- Explore the benefits of cloud-native development practices.
- Analyze the current tool ecosystem and their promises.
- Evaluate the reliability of generative AI and LLMs.
- Discover the future trends in software development.

This episode is perfect for developers, tech enthusiasts, and anyone interested in the future of software development. Gain valuable insights into the transformative trends shaping the industry.

🔍 How do you think the shift to a spec-centric approach will impact the future of software development? Share your thoughts below! 👇

00:00 - Introduction to AI Native Development

08:10 - Challenges in the Current Ecosystem  
10:00 - Copilots, Autonomy, and Differentiation  
13:00 - From Code-Centric to Spec-Centric Development  
19:00 - The Evolving Role of Developers  
25:00 - Future Outlook and Closing Thoughts
